Predoctoral Researcher (European Expectations Center)

Predoctoral Researcher (gn)

Support research at the European Expectations Center in Berlin. The full-time role starts in July 2027 and can last up to two years.

What makes you a great fit

A bachelor's or master's degree in Economics, Finance, Behavioral Sciences, or related fields; quantitative skills and plans to pursue a doctorate.

How you will make a difference

Organise datasets, conduct statistical analysis, and support economics research reports and papers.
